HUNT-RSSI-DEBOUNCE-R2
# PR #215 R2: fix R1 0% / NO SIGNAL flicker while a target is still active.
# R1 5s expiry was too short for passive 13-channel WiFi sweeping and BLE
# coex advertisement gaps. R2 uses radio-aware grace windows:
#   BLE: 9 seconds; WiFi: 15 seconds (more than three ~4s channel sweeps).
# New received packets refresh RSSI immediately. On confirmed absence,
# strength is still 0% / NO SIGNAL, NOT 0 dBm or the frozen last sample.
# Post-loss reacquisition resets stale trend and CAUGHT history; a normal
# missed sweep does not reset the RSSI history or trigger spurious HOT.
# Both HUNT roster and full-screen gauge share the same transport timeout.
# Added virtual-radio intermittent reception tests with 7s BLE / 12s WiFi
# packets over several minutes plus genuine loss/recovery and millis rollover.
# LAB only: CYD 2.8 ST7789 + 3.2 ST7798 hardware testing required.
# Preserve PR #214 and master. No merge, tag or production release.
